findings.finding: Standalone native TP2 uses physical GPUs 4,6, not4,5. A four-device reservation is not always a four-rank TP world.
findings.remedy: Name each layout separately. Native TP4: GPUs 4/5/6/7 to ranks 0/1/2/3. Standalone TP2: GPUs 4/6 to ranks 0/1. TP2xDP2: groups 4/5 and 6/7, each with ranks 0/1. DP4: singleton-visible GPU 0 in each worker.

findings.finding: The linked completed long-context report identifies the previous local cap as 10240, not 4096.
findings.remedy: Say these controls exceed the earlier local 10240-token runtime cap. Do not infer natural quality or numerical validity at the configured 65536 maximum.

findings.finding: The referenced artifacts/model_runtime_manifest.json does not exist.
findings.remedy: Link artifacts/semantics_manifest.json for model/runtime semantics. Use artifacts/environment_manifest.json separately for device/environment metadata.

findings.finding: The 14/16 raw-median ranking mixes native API wall with parent release-to-completion wall. Its arithmetic does not supply a common-endpoint method ranking.
findings.remedy: Omit the ranking or attach an explicit mixed-clock label and say it does not establish a common-endpoint winner.

findings.finding: Native depth counters can be mistaken for native vLLM adaptive TP. The quoted mean depths exclude the first output token produced by full-R4 prefill.
findings.remedy: Use CDB runtime counters. State that decode-depth accounting excludes prefill and its first output token. State that single-GPU reference execution does not validate adaptive TP2/TP4.

findings.finding: Adaptive full-R4 prefill is sampled already, but adaptive decode is not. Fixed/adaptive prefill values are duplicate measurements. The 2048-wide input is not the 5632-wide down-projection operand.
findings.remedy: Keep 2448 as scoped row-pair records. State duplicate prefill coverage. Replace unresolved adaptive mode with adaptive decode and uncaptured down-projection input, alongside projection parity/cost and broader workloads.

findings.finding: The best permitted static depth partition is chosen in hindsight from each observed exit histogram. This is not a causal online scheduling policy.
findings.remedy: Add the hindsight assumption and link the complete extension screen. Keep normalized-capacity ratios separate from GPU throughput and native TP4 speedup.

findings.finding: Independent KV slots can be misread as separate physical allocations or a universal storage lower bound.
findings.remedy: Rename the header to Logical depth/layer KV slots. Keep fixed-R4 version independence distinct from allocator packing and adaptive terminal-version aliasing.

findings.finding: Work is broader than the measured controlled-work completion claim.
findings.remedy: Say Conventional controls complete the declared controlled hardware workload on authorized H100 devices. Do not imply natural-generation quality or full numerical parity.

findings.finding: The duration and pending-run statements are time-sensitive. This review did not re-audit coordinator duration or inspect the pending native extension.
findings.remedy: Add the draft creation UTC and a specific coordinator-ledger snapshot link/hash. Keep native-extension status explicitly as-of that snapshot.
